dimensions.summary: Agent & Memory owns one active-vault PIGE.md editor; failed outcomes retain the draft and Activity owns exact committed Undo.
Markdown, API, Settings, UI and D-20260801-Vault-Pige-Policy-Editor agree on structure validation, explicit confirmation and pathless CAS.
Direct schema, service, IPC, registry and Settings tests bind validation, currentness, recovery and Undo without claiming broader Agent preference completion.
A bounded policy owner reuses existing vault, confirmation, Operation and Activity boundaries without granting mutation authority to content or extensions.
Existing Markdown, API, Settings and UI owners plus one durable Decision absorb the editor without adding a duplicate design document.
